title: ShortSport: Auto-scroll, Comments & Sharing, Profile Navigation

requirements.text: In ShortSportPage, add a click-to-activate auto-scroll mode: when the user clicks a video, enable auto-scroll so that once the current video finishes playing it automatically scrolls to the next video in the feed. Each subsequent video should do the same — play fully then scroll to the next one automatically.

quotes: auto scroll works when it is clicked and if clicked it automatically scroll down the next video after completing the previous video

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a video activates auto-scroll mode for that session
After the active video finishes playing, the page automatically scrolls to the next video
The next video begins playing and the same auto-scroll behavior continues
If there is no next video, auto-scroll stops gracefully
Auto-scroll does not trigger before the video has finished playing

requirements.text: Add a comments section to each ShortSport item: display a comment box (inline or as a bottom drawer/sheet) showing all existing comments from all users, and allow authenticated users to post new comments. Reuse the existing comments backend (addComment / getComments) already used in PostCard and CommentsSheet.

quotes: their iss a comment box where all coments are visible to all user

acceptanceCriteria: Each ShortSport item has a comment icon/button
Tapping the comment button opens a comments panel showing all existing comments for that post
Comments display the commenter's username/avatar and comment text
Authenticated users can type and submit a new comment
New comments appear immediately after submission (optimistic or refetch)
Comment count updates visibly on the ShortSport item

requirements.text: Add a share button to each ShortSport item that allows the current user to share the video or picture to their friends using the existing friend system. Opening the share UI should show a list of the user's friends so they can select recipients and send the post as a direct message (reusing the existing messaging backend).

quotes: share option to share the video or picture to their friends

acceptanceCriteria: Each ShortSport item has a share icon/button
Tapping share opens a modal or bottom sheet listing the current user's friends
The user can select one or more friends and confirm to share
The post is sent as a message to the selected friend(s) using the existing messaging system
A success confirmation is shown after sharing

requirements.text: Display the poster's profile avatar and username/display name on each ShortSport item (overlay on the video, e.g. bottom-left). Tapping the avatar or name navigates directly to that user's full profile page (UserProfilePage) using their principal ID.

quotes: add profile logo and name of user who post the shortsport
when some click on it the clicker(who click) directly see the profile page of the user who post the video

acceptanceCriteria: Each ShortSport item displays the poster's avatar and display name as an overlay on the video/image
The avatar falls back to gradient initials if no profile picture is set (reusing AvatarPlaceholder component)
Clicking/tapping the avatar or name navigates to the poster's UserProfilePage
Navigation uses the poster's principal ID in the route (consistent with existing user profile routing)

constraints: Only modify files that are strictly necessary — do not refactor or rewrite unrelated components
Reuse existing backend calls (addComment, getComments, sendMessage, getFriends) — do not add new backend endpoints unless absolutely required
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
Reuse CommentsSheet or its logic where possible rather than duplicating comment functionality
nonGoals: Adding new backend data models or actor state beyond what already exists
Redesigning or restyling the ShortSport page layout beyond what is needed for the new UI elements
Implementing real-time comment updates (polling or live refresh not required)
Changing the friend system or messaging system logic
